C08-M06-L01-F1.title: The Pyramid of Pain, mapped to the Banyan case
C08-M06-L01-F1.caption: David Bianco's six indicator levels, from trivial to replace at the base to tough at the top, each with an example from the lab dataset.
C08-M06-L01-F1.alt: Pyramid of six stacked bands, narrow at the top. From top to bottom: TTPs, tough, phish then spray then exfiltrate; Tools, challenging, the loader that beacons; Network and host artefacts, annoying, /api/v2/ping every 300 s; Domain names, simple, cdn-telemetry-sync.example; IP addresses, easy, 203.0.113.66; Hash values, trivial, the invoice.docm SHA-256. Note: the higher the level, the more it costs the adversary to change and the longer the indicator stays useful.
C08-M06-L01-F1.note: The higher the level, the more it costs the adversary to change and the longer the indicator stays useful.

C08-M06-L01-F2.title: Indicators in the lab: class, level, shelf life, telemetry
C08-M06-L01-F2.caption: Each indicator met in the Banyan case placed by structural class and pyramid level, with its typical shelf life and the data it must match against.
C08-M06-L01-F2.alt: Table with five columns: Indicator (lab), Class, Pyramid level, Shelf life, Telemetry needed. Row 1: 9f2c...e1a0 (invoice.docm), computed, hash, precise but soon irrelevant, file hashes (EDR, mail gateway), not collected in the lab. Row 2: 203.0.113.66, atomic, IP address, days (window 7 days), VPN or firewall source IP. Row 3: cdn-telemetry-sync.example, atomic, domain, weeks to months (window 58 days), proxy or DNS logs. Row 4: banyan-payroll-update.example, atomic, domain (look-alike), while registered (window 27 days), proxy or DNS logs. Row 5: beacon, 300 s, cv 0.004, computed, network artefact, life of the tooling, proxy timestamps and sizes. Row 6: R1 Word starts PowerShell, behavioural, TTP, long, Sysmon process creation with parent. Rows run from slate and blue tones to red and dark.
rows: File hashes (EDR, mail gateway): not in lab
C08-M06-L01-F2.note: Type predicts both lifetime and data needs: the best-graded indicator in the feed (the hash) could not match because the lab collects no hashes.
